welcome.title: Welcome to MVOS Lab
welcome.content: Welcome to the Machine Vision and Optical Sensor (MVOS) Lab at South Dakota State University. We are dedicated to advancing precision agriculture through innovative research and cutting-edge technology that transforms how farmers monitor, manage, and optimize their crops. Our interdisciplinary team specializes in developing hyperspectral imaging systems, autonomous robotic platforms, and AI-powered analytics to detect crop diseases, assess plant health, and enable precision application of treatments. Located within the Department of Agricultural & Biosystems Engineering, we collaborate with students, faculty, and industry partners to create solutions that improve food security and enhance farm productivity.
